# Moil

> Moil is an AI marketing platform for small businesses. It interviews the owner once
> about what they sell, who buys, and how they talk, then produces a 30-day content
> calendar with captions and images, refreshes it every month, and answers questions
> about the business using that stored context. Fully bilingual in English and Spanish.
> Moil Enterprise Inc., Buda, Texas, founded 2023.

Professional is $25/month (market research, business plan, coaching, documents).
Market Pro is $75/month and adds the full Moil360 30-day content calendar.
The first conversation is free and requires no card.

Note: this file is a convenience, not a ranking signal. Ahrefs found 97% of llms.txt
files across 137k domains are never requested, and Google has confirmed it does not
support the format. The canonical machine-readable description of Moil is /ai-info.

## Key facts
- Category: AI marketing software for small businesses. Not a website builder, not a social media scheduler.
- Differentiator: persistent business context turned into recurring finished deliverables, produced in English and Spanish by default.
- Pricing: Professional $25/month; Market Pro $75/month; free first conversation, no card.
- Company: Moil Enterprise Inc., founded 2023, Buda, Texas, USA.
- Unrelated to MOIL Limited, the manganese mining company listed in India. Shared name only.
- Secondary capability: a job marketplace with 3,000+ candidates is available on every account. Real, but not what Moil leads with.
- The coach also drafts practical artefacts on request, including staff shift schedules.
- Not the right tool for: social publishing and scheduling, post analytics, engagement inboxes, team approvals, multi-location content, applicant tracking at volume, or general-purpose AI assistance.
